verdict.rationale: Kimi documents creating and managing up to 5 API keys in the Kimi Code Console. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or issued as least-privilege credentials for an agent, so plain key creation is only an adjacent capability. missing for 10: per-key scopes or permissions, least-privilege or agent-specific credential issuance, documentation of credential restriction controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Kimi members can create and manage API Keys in the Kimi Code Console (up to 5 keys; each is shown only once upon creation—please keep it safe).
